# Step 3: Design for Large Devices

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Step 3: Design for Large Devices

The design you need to create for larger devices (e.g., laptops, desktops, TVs) is:

![Responsive Navbar for Large Devices](data:image/png;base64,)

So, you can use another media query to add the CSS rules for even bigger devices (above 900px) as,

```css
/* For large screen sizes */
@media (min-width: 901px) {
    .navbar {
        justify-content: space-around;
    }

    .nav-links {
        gap: 4rem;
    }

    .nav-links a {
        font-size: 1.2rem;
    }
}
```
